title: Kerala High Court restores police protection to Kumbh Mela fame Monalisa
description: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday restored the interim police protection granted to Kumbh Mela fame Monalisa.Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas passed the order after Monalisa informed the Court that she had approached the police and sought protection in writing, as directed earlier by the Court."Since the petitioner has now approached the police, the interim order directing grant of police protection shall continue," said the Court.Justice Bechu Kurian ThomasThe Court also added Station House Officer (
